scope: Real Node HTTP client and owned SQL claim bridge; fake WhatsApp sender, no Baileys or recipient contacted

tests.name: Node readiness checks the authenticated SQL bridge without probing a token
SQL health refuses an incorrect key
Real Node client and SQL claim bridge complete one fake acknowledged send
Consumed delivery cannot replay through a second Node recipient
Concurrent Node recipients obtain only one SQL claim and one send
Failed fake send remains uncertain in the actual database
Lost recipient acknowledgement makes one attempt and holds the SQL claim without tier retries
Lost completion acknowledgement keeps the actual claim held
Actual PHP-issued token completes its assigned-bot Node delivery
The PHP-issued token remains consumed after completion
